name: Metalquest Mining Inc.
summary: MetalQuest Mining Inc. is an exploration-stage company that acquires, explores and develops mineral properties in Canada, exploring for gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc and iron. Its flagship is its full interest in the Lac Otelnuk Iron Ore Project in the Labrador Trough region of northern Quebec. Formerly El Nino Ventures Inc., it was incorporated in 1988.
